subject: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate you and Rajiv taking the time. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment for the evaluation: 

1) Goal: Finexa wants to prototype an LLM-powered financial assistant for customer support (sensitive PII redaction + audit logs required).
2) Recommended initial mode: Hosted API evaluation so you can iterate fast (no infra to provision). We can move to Dedicated or Private VPC if you need predictable throughput or on-prem data residency.

Quickstart checklist (attached guide):
- Create a project in the Console: https://console.redwood.ai/quickstart/finexa
- API key: Generate under Settings -> API Keys (scoped to project).
- Test endpoint (POST): https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/hosted/generate
  - Body: {"model":"redwood-1.2-large","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}
- Chat endpoint (streaming supported): wss://stream.redwood-inference.com/v1/chat/stream

Rate limits for Hosted evaluation tier (typical trial):
- 150 requests/minute (sustained), burst up to 300 requests/min for short periods
- Concurrency per API key: 20 concurrent requests
- Token throughput: ~1.5M tokens/day soft cap for trials (we can raise for short evals)

Security & compliance notes:
- Hosted API supports encryption-at-rest, SOC2 artifacts available on request.
- If you need VPC/private deployment for regulated data, we can scope a Private deployment conversation in parallel.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (step-by-step), integration spreadsheet template.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm whether you want to run the evaluation on Hosted API (fastest) or require Dedicated/Private from day 1.
- If Hosted: I can provision a trial API key and raise the token cap to 3M tokens/day for two weeks.
- Schedule a 30-min integration session with our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) — we have availability Wed/Thu morning PST.

Thanks — I can get the trial key ready once you confirm.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0197

Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we kick off: 

- Data residency: For the initial prototype we prefer Hosted if data is tokenized/PII redacted by our side, but our security team will want to confirm that logs are handled per contract. Can you confirm whether request/response logs are retained by default and how to opt out?
- Throughput: We expect a peak of ~400k tokens/day during the pilot, but if the prototype shows promise we could ramp to several million tokens/month. If you can provision 3M tokens/day for the two-week window that should be enough.
- Rate limits: 150 r/min with burst to 300 should be fine for initial experiments; just want to confirm concurrency behavior for long-running chat sessions.

Assuming the answers look good, we want to proceed with Hosted evaluation. Please provision the trial key and schedule a session with Marissa — Thu morning PST works for our team.

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Product, Finexa
Samantha.Lee@finexa.com

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Iyer <rajiv.iyer@finexa.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Samantha —

Great, thanks for the details. Answers inline below: 

- Request/Response logs: By default we retain request/response logs for 30 days for troubleshooting and cost analytics. You can enable "no-logging" for a project which will prevent storing full request/response bodies (we still store minimal metadata for billing). For regulated pilots we recommend Hosted + no-logging, or Dedicated/Private if you require zero retention. I can share our SOC2 package and a short AR/retention guide — attaching SOC2 summary PDF on request.

- Token provisioning: I will provision a trial with a soft cap of 3M tokens/day for your project for the two-week eval window. If you need more, we can raise it temporarily (just ping me).

- Concurrency/long-running chat: Concurrency limit is per API key (20 by default on trial). Long-running streaming chat sessions consume a concurrency slot while open; we can increase concurrency on the trial key if your sessions are long-lived. For reference, many customers use our streaming websocket and manage session heartbeats to avoid accidental slot exhaustion.

I’ve attached the quickstart guide and the integration template (finexa-map-of-integration.xlsx).

Next actions:
1) I’ll provision the trial API key and send credentials to you and Rajiv by EOD.
2) Marissa will set up the integration session Thursday 09:00 PST — I’ll send the calendar invite.
3) Please loop in your security contact if you want the SOC2 summary and retention doc prior to the session.

Cheers,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
